_comment: content.map fragment for templates/_library/sections/faq-accordion. Rule reference: editor-fill.js header comment. 'from':'faq' is Create Event's columns-shape library id for this; items are {t: question, d: answer}. In the editor, opening one answer to edit it needs template.json → sections[].toggle: { item: '.faq-item', open: 'active', expanded: '.faq-question' } (see templates/README.md and templates/tech500/template.json's own 'frequently-asked-questions' entry) wired on whichever template includes this section — not something this fragment itself can declare.
